description: Encouragement quotes for Victorian Christmas Solitaire celebrations

hearts.quote: Brilliant move! Your strategy shines like holly berries!
Marvelous! Your grace in play is unmatched!
Excellent work! Keep that momentum going!

diamonds.quote: Magnificent! Your skill sparkles like winter frost!
Wonderfully done! Your elegance shows through!

spades.quote: Outstanding! Your wisdom grows like the mighty oak!
Beautiful play! Nature itself would applaud!

clubs.quote: Superb! Your moves are sweeter than candy!
Delightful! Your strategy is perfectly sweet!

general.quote: Victory is yours! A game well played!
Splendid! Every move brings you closer to triumph!
Well done! Your skills are truly remarkable!

howToUse: 1. Copy this template to a new file named 'encouragement_quotes.json'
2. Replace the example quotes with your 30 encouragement quotes
3. Organize quotes by suit (hearts, diamonds, spades, clubs)
4. Specify cardType (king, queen, jack) to assign appropriate voice
5. Add general quotes that work for any suit

voiceMapping.king: Deep, authoritative male voice (130 wpm, 80 Hz pitch)
voiceMapping.queen: Elegant female voice (150 wpm, 200 Hz pitch)
voiceMapping.jack: Energetic male tenor (170 wpm, 160 Hz pitch)

cardTypeOptions: generic - Use voicePreference field to specify
triggerOptions: king_placed - King card placed on foundation
queen_placed - Queen card placed on foundation
jack_placed - Jack card placed on foundation
perfect_game - Player wins with no mistakes
